entities.summary: Dejan Bojkov is a Bulgarian chess grandmaster and chess author. He earned his grandmaster title in 2008 and won the 48th Canadian Open Chess Championship in 2011. He worked for Antoaneta Stefanova as her trainer. He has also been running frequent training sessions with the New Zealand chess team.
